summary.headline: Astrological Codex Entries 432–451
summary.text: Florentine codex entries 432–451 cover astrological timing, finding the horoscoping sign and planet at nativity, oil-divination, star risings, commanding and obeying degrees, inglorious and equipollent degrees, pivoting and burning stars, horoscopes including Persian methods, Kinti declinations, the conjunction of Selech, rejoicing and exalted stars, masculine and feminine degrees, Critodemus’s hostile places and apheses, and lunar occultation. Autolycus on the risings of stars is cited in Hultsch’s 1885 edition, with a further reference to Kroll on Critodemus.
